# Why does my QIF file import with the wrong dates?

> Free QIF checker: finds why a QIF file imports with the wrong month, twice, or not at all (no !Type header, missing ^, mixed date order, bad amounts, unbalanced splits), with line numbers, and writes a repaired file. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). The file is read in your browser and never uploaded. It checks the structure of bank, card, cash and investment (!Type:Invst) records and of the list sections of a full Quicken export; it does not check that balances or categories are right. Not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
